item_arguments_and_dependencies.argument: Defines locally finite homotopy types, rational component weights, finite-support functions and weighted homotopy-fiber pushforward; the component-ratio lemma proves finiteness.
Compares the same homotopy fibers termwise and proves pullback of a proper component map remains proper.
Uses the mapping-path fibration LES, computes the low-degree component tail and cancels finite group orders.
States finite-total-Hom cohomology, cohomological signs, right-module convention, projective enhancement, stable cofibers and mapping-space Ext grading.
Multiplies componentwise ratios and cancels intermediate homotopy groups in the composite.
Defines arrow and composable-pair homotopy types, source/target/cofiber maps, and the source/cofiber pull-push product.
Starts with representables via dg Yoneda and propagates finite total Ext through shifts, sums, cones and retracts.
Proves local finiteness of object, arrow and pair types, counts extension components by Ext1, and establishes properness and finite support.
Derives the low-degree stabilizer tail and higher Ext exact sequence from mapping spaces in the slice, then proves the weight by finite exact-order cancellation.
Proves the first square by a mapping-cone coordinate change and the second by reconstructing the middle object as a stable homotopy pullback.
Identifies coefficient components with Aut(x)-orbits, imports the proved stabilizer weight, sums, and applies finite orbit-stabilizer.
Expands both nested convolutions, uses proper base change along source/cofiber, identifies common triple data, and checks both unit fibers.
Uses t-structure orthogonality to eliminate negative Ext, identifies monomorphism orbits with Hall subobjects, and records the opposite convention.
Records exact differences in coefficient, generators and axiom/model assumptions without claiming an unsupported algebra nonisomorphism.
Computes all maps S→S⊕S[1], their cones, automorphism orbits and the missing q^-1 Ext factor.
Verifies the A2 heart is finitary and hereditary, enumerates scalar-arrow orbits and S2 subobjects, and applies the opposite-heart embedding.
